text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the debut race has finally 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete! Arriving full 
of fighting spirit, only to enter the 
wrong waiting room... Making a blunder 
right when it counts—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The debut race has officially begun!
